title: F01 · result_day · Result Day
lines: The result is on the screen. And your parents are on the other side of that door.
The family group is already asking.
Kabir climbed to the roof so nobody would see his face.
Someone was already sitting up there, looking at the moon.
It was full two weeks ago. It will be full again.
Kabir went down, opened the door,
and said the number out loud.
A number is one night of the moon. Not the moon. That is sadhana.
